string.name: syncAuditLogRowTitle
string.instruction: Title of one row in a list of device activity. First placeholder is how long ago it happened, for example 3 days ago. Second placeholder is Synced or Removed

plurals.name: syncNewDeviceBannerTitle
plurals.instruction: Title of a message in Sync settings. The number is how many new devices synced with this account. Do not show the number

string.name: syncNewDeviceBannerBody
string.instruction: Message in Sync settings. Placeholder is one device name, or a list of device names

string.name: syncNewDeviceBannerLastName
string.instruction: Joins the last device name to a list. First placeholder is the earlier device names, separated by commas. Second placeholder is the last device name

plurals.name: syncNewDeviceBannerMore
plurals.instruction: Ends a list of device names. Placeholder 1 is the device names, separated by commas. Placeholder 2 is how many more devices synced

plurals.name: syncAuditLogMinutesAgo
plurals.instruction: Placeholder is the number of minutes since a device was synced or removed

plurals.name: syncAuditLogHoursAgo
plurals.instruction: Placeholder is the number of hours since a device was synced or removed

plurals.name: syncAuditLogDaysAgo
plurals.instruction: Placeholder is the number of days since a device was synced or removed

plurals.name: syncAuditLogMonthsAgo
plurals.instruction: Placeholder is the number of months since a device was synced or removed

plurals.name: syncAuditLogYearsAgo
plurals.instruction: Placeholder is the number of years since a device was synced or removed
